name: In-Flight Hot Herbal Tea (BYO Peppermint / Chamomile Tea Bag Hack)
brandOrRestaurant: Airline Hot Water + BYO Herbal Sachet
whyItWorks: A flight-tested pro tip for IBD travelers: Pack organic peppermint or chamomile tea bags in your pocket. Ask the flight attendant for a cup of plain hot water. Warmth soothes abdominal muscle spasms and eases flight anxiety with zero caffeine.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Carry 2–3 wrapped herbal tea bags in your carry-on. Ask the flight attendant during beverage service: 'May I please have a cup of hot water with a slice of lemon?' Drop in your tea bag.
